en.answer: The ATK and DEF changed by the effect of <<13024>> are not treated as the new original ATK and DEF. For example, if the effect is applied to <<13023>>, its ATK and DEF each become 4400 until the end of the turn, but its original ATK remains 3000 and its original DEF remains 1400.
en.question: When the third effect of <<13024>> makes the ATK and DEF of a "Subterror" monster on the field become equal to its combined original ATK and DEF, is the new ATK and DEF treated as a new original ATK and DEF?
en.title: When the third effect of <<13024>> makes the ATK and DEF of a "Subterror" monster on the field become equal to its combined original ATK and DEF, is the new ATK and DEF treated as a new original ATK and DEF?

ja.answer:
「<<13024>>」の『そのモンスターの攻撃力・守備力はターン終了時まで、その元々の攻撃力と守備力を合計した数値になる』効果によって適用された攻撃力・守備力の数値は、元々の攻撃力・守備力としては扱われません。

例えば、「<<13023>>」に「<<13024>>」の効果が適用された場合、ターン終了時まで攻撃力4400・守備力4400の状態となりますが、元々の攻撃力は3000、元々の守備力は1400のままです。
